column1: # Custom partition table for the 16MB flash on this board (W25Q128 per the
# schematic -- double the CrowPanel build's 8MB). Same rationale as that
# build's partitions.csv: give the app a comfortable but not wasteful slice
# and hand the rest to LittleFS for book storage.
# otadata/ota_0 are kept even though this firmware never does an OTA update:
# the Arduino ESP32 bootloader always expects an otadata slot and uses
# boot_app0.bin (flashed automatically) to point it at ota_0 on first boot.
